description: Sign a new shop up for its owner in one call. Send accept_terms: true to accept the Terms of Service for the shop, with the owner's name and email. The reply has a link to the Terms, the version, and an agent key for the new shop; every feature works right away. We email the owner the full Terms with the version and date.

accept_terms.description: true: you accept the Terms of Service for the shop

accept_terms_version.description: Optional: the Terms version you reviewed (now terms-2026-10-31e). Refused if it is not the current one.

agent_name.description: Your name, used as the key label
